The '''Mystic Tree Seed''' is a [[Trees|tree]] seed that grows into a [[Mystic Tree]]. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Foraging Mastery]]. 

Mystic Tree Seeds can only be obtained by crafting. They cannot be obtained from chopping or shaking Mystic Trees. Mystic Trees do not spread seeds when fully grown.<ref name="mysticseed" />

Mystic Tree Seeds fertilized with [[Tree Fertilizer]] have a 30% chance of growing to the next stage each night, including during [[Winter]]. Unfertilized seeds have a 15% chance of growing to the next stage each night during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]].<ref name="mysticseed" />

Mystic Tree Seeds cannot be planted around the border of the [[Greenhouse]].
